evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 西峰秀色
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北逺山村西南有室臨河西向為西峯秀色河西松巒峻峙為小匡廬後有龍王廟西峯秀色之東為含韻齋又東為一堂和氣又東南為自得軒後垣東為嵐鏡舫西為花港觀魚（圓明園册）臣等謹按西峯秀色四十景之一兹額及含韻齋一堂和氣自得軒額皆世宗御書嵐鏡舫花港觀魚諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: A room facing west on the river: 西峯秀色, with the pine rock 小匡廬 and a 龍王廟 across the water, 含韻齋, 一堂和氣, 自得軒, 嵐鏡舫 and 花港觀魚.

evidence.title: 西峰秀色
evidence.locator: v2 p.260, under 西峰秀色; source ref 2-687
evidence.excerpt_zh: 轩楹洞达，面临翠巘。西山爽气，在我襟袖。后宇为含韵斋，周植玉兰十余本。方春花气袭人，宛入众香国里。垲地高轩架木为，朱明飒爽如秋时。不雕不斵太古意，讵惟其丽惟其宜。西窗正对西山启，遥接峣峰等尺咫。霜辰红叶诗思杜，雨夕绿螺画看米。亦有童童盘盖松，重基特立孰与同。三冬百卉凋零尽，依然郁翠惟此翁。山腰兰若云遮半，一声清磬风吹断。疑有苾刍单上参，不如诗客窗中玩。结构既久苍苔老，花棚药畤相萦抱。凭栏送目无不佳，趺榻怡神良复好。春朝秋夜值几余，把卷时还读我书。斋外水田凡数顷，较晴量雨谘农夫。清词丽句个中得，消几丁丁玉壶刻。但忆趋庭十载前，徊徨无语予心恻
evidence.summary: Poem 西峰秀色 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1744, filed by the editors under 西峰秀色.

evidence.title: 西峰秀色: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.242 item (2), under 西峰秀色
evidence.excerpt_zh: 太行千里卫神京。层叠峰岩耸翠迎。云外浮岚虚牖接，雨余秀色小窗呈。阶前渐觉花香转，林际徐闻鸟语清。罨画远山来眼底，都含新润景充盈。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 西峰秀色, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 西峰秀色: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.242 item (3), under 西峰秀色
evidence.excerpt_zh: 浮岚飞翠入窗中，景纳苍茫百里通。枫染锦屏凝绛雪，柳拖金缕舞回风。参差远岫开青障，层叠晴霞散碧空。未得遍探岩壑美，凭虚览胜赏心同。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 西峰秀色, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 西峰秀色
evidence.locator: v2 p.272, under 西峰秀色; source ref 1-219
evidence.excerpt_zh: 蜃窗纳景列西峰，叠叠烟岚槛外供。大岭脉遥来自晋，阴崖雪厚积由冬。开襟远岫苍茫接，倒影寒潭紫翠浓。更上层楼延秀色，云蒸霞蔚百千重。
evidence.summary: Poem 西峰秀色 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 西峰秀色.

evidence.title: 西峰秀色: 嘉庆十六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十六年 (1811), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.243 item (14), under 西峰秀色
evidence.excerpt_zh: 远峰飞秀入帘拢，试启西窗坐画中。霞绚层崖光映日，云生高岭气凌空。溟蒙红润花溪甘，泽漾青连柳岸风。夏景清和心静契，虔祈甘泽莆田充。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 西峰秀色, 1811, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: Scene 27, 西峰秀色 Xifeng Xiuse
evidence.excerpt_other: Instead of facing south, as did most buildings in North China, both inside and outside the palace, the open pavilion, for which this group was named, faced west across the low rice fields,
evidence.summary: Open pavilion facing west across low rice fields; ten to twenty magnolias in the court behind it. Yongzheng liked to live here.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 西峰秀色
evidence.summary: Of 1728, Yongzheng's favourite. A three-bay open hall facing west, once with a stage for the Double Seventh; 含韵斋 of five bays in three rolls; 玉兰堂, 自得轩, 小隐亭, twelve-bay 岚镜舫, a seven-bay hall 花港观鱼 over the river, 长青洲, the 小匡庐 cascade.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 西峰秀色
evidence.locator: from p.241, under 西峰秀色
evidence.summary: The compiler describes the main hall 含韵斋 as five bays in three rolls with galleries and magnolias, an open hall to the west and, across the water, the small cascade 小匡庐. 西峰秀色: short note in the compilation, no dated items.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
